name: B10-0211/2025 (Renew) – Targeted attacks against Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo – defending religious freedom and security
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the targeted attacks against Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: defending religious freedom and security
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and asking others to act. It asks Rwanda to pull its troops out of the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and stop helping the M23 armed group. It asks for an immediate ceasefire, more aid for displaced people, and new sanctions on those behind the violence. It also calls for better protection of Christians and other religious communities.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is a set of demands, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Rwanda, the Congo government, armed groups, and civilians in the east.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to the Council, the Commission and both governments; they decide whether to act.
